info.title: TD.J40 Shared link and consent API
info.description: What the home country records when the holder shares a family member's summary as a Verifiable Health Link (VHL): who may read what, for how long, and that a passcode protects it.

get.summary: JSON Schema definition for the Logical Model StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdVhlShare
get.description: This endpoint serves the JSON Schema definition for the Logical Model StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdVhlShare.

StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdVhlShare.title: TD.J40 Shared link and consent
StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdVhlShare.description: What the home country records when the holder shares a family member's summary as a Verifiable Health Link (VHL): who may read what, for how long, and that a passcode protects it.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for TrustDemoDdVhlShare logical model

subject.description: The family member whose summary is shared.

holder.description: The person who shares the link and decides who may open it.

custodian.description: The home-country service that hosts the record and checks every request.

sharedDocument.description: The patient summary the link releases.

validFrom.description: The first day the link may be opened.

validUntil.description: The expiry the holder chose; after it the link releases nothing (STD-ACC-001).

purpose.description: The purpose of use the holder allows (J4: treatment).

passcodeSet.description: Whether the holder protected the link with a passcode. The passcode itself is never stored in the record.

withdrawnAt.description: When the holder withdrew the link, if they did.
